auth.model: public visitor flow with booking lookup by reference and email
rules: no account is required to book a picking slot
a booking is displayed only when the entered reference and email match the stored reservation
newsletter signup does not require an account

routes.name: Home
routes.purpose: Marketing landing page with seasonal announcement, booking call-to-action, how it works, farm highlights, practical visitor information, testimonials and newsletter signup.

routes.name: Book a picking slot
routes.purpose: Multi-step reservation flow for selecting date, timed slot, party size, customer details, farm terms and confirmation.

routes.name: Manage booking
routes.purpose: Lookup and cancellation entry point for existing reservations using booking reference and email.

routes.name: Plan your visit
routes.purpose: Practical visitor information including opening hours, what to bring, etiquette, weather guidance, accessibility and directions.

routes.name: Our Farm
routes.purpose: Farm story, sustainable growing practices and team or farm photography-style content.

summary: A polished customer-facing website and booking system for Berry Brook Farm where visitors learn about the farm, reserve timed strawberry-picking slots, and manage reservations by reference and email.

deferred.item: real card payment or deposit collection
deferred.reason: the requested experience labels payment as on-arrival and strawberries are paid by weight at the farm
the application must not use external APIs and will show a map-style visual with written directions

deferred.item: real calendar file download or calendar provider integration
deferred.reason: the requested add-to-calendar-style action is a demo interaction and no external calendar integration is required
weather guidance is displayed as static visitor advice without external API calls
the request is for a customer-facing website and booking management by visitors
the requested farm-field imagery can be represented with tasteful visual placeholders and illustrated motifs
visitors manage reservations using booking reference and email rather than signing in

entities.name: booking
relationships: a booking references one seeded in-code date and timed slot
active bookings reduce the visible remaining capacity for their referenced slot

steps.expect: a hero section is visible with the heading 'Strawberry season is here' and a prominent 'Book a picking slot' call-to-action
the booking page opens and shows step 1 with available dates for the next several weeks
the selected date is highlighted and timed 90-minute picking slots with availability indicators are visible
the selected slot is highlighted and the visitor count step becomes available
the booking summary updates with date, time, party size, reservation deposit or entry fee messaging, and 'strawberries paid by weight on arrival'

steps.action: enter name, email and phone, accept the farm terms, and submit
steps.expect: a confirmation state appears with a booking reference, arrival instructions, and an add-to-calendar-style action

steps.action: reload the page and look up the reservation by reference and email
steps.expect: the same reservation details are displayed after the reload

journeys.title: A visitor reserves an available strawberry picking slot
acceptance: a reservation created in the browser remains retrievable by booking reference and email after a full page reload
the confirmation displays a unique booking reference and the selected date, time and party size
a slot at capacity cannot be selected for a new reservation

steps.expect: a lookup form is visible with booking reference and email fields

steps.action: submit a valid booking reference and matching email
steps.expect: the reservation details are shown with date, time, party size, contact information and a cancel option

steps.action: click the cancel option and confirm cancellation
steps.expect: the reservation status changes to 'Cancelled' and the slot availability increases by the cancelled party size

steps.action: search again for the cancelled reservation
steps.expect: the reservation is shown with a visible 'Cancelled' status and no active cancel button

journeys.title: A visitor looks up and cancels an existing reservation
acceptance: a matching reference and email displays the correct reservation
a non-matching email displays a friendly 'We could not find that reservation' message
a cancelled reservation is visibly marked as cancelled when looked up again

steps.action: open the plan your visit page
steps.expect: opening hours, what to bring, field etiquette, weather guidance, accessibility information and directions are visible
a map-style visual placeholder is visible with Berry Brook Farm location details
the farm story, sustainable growing practices and team or farm photography-style panels are visible

journeys.title: A visitor browses practical farm information
acceptance: the visit page displays parking, accessibility, dogs and picnic policy information
the our farm page displays sustainable growing practice content
navigation links move between home, book now, plan your visit and our farm without a page error

steps.expect: a newsletter signup section is visible

steps.action: enter a valid email address and submit
steps.expect: a success message confirms the visitor has joined the Berry Brook Farm seasonal updates list

steps.action: enter an invalid email address and submit
steps.expect: an inline validation message says the email must look like an email address

journeys.title: A visitor signs up for seasonal farm updates
acceptance: a valid newsletter signup shows a visible success message
an invalid newsletter signup keeps the form visible and shows an email validation message
submitting an already-signed-up email shows a friendly message that the address is already on the list

steps.action: open the site on a narrow viewport
steps.expect: a menu button and persistent 'Book now' call-to-action are visible
navigation links for Home, Book Now, Plan Your Visit and Our Farm are visible
the selected page opens and the mobile menu closes

journeys.title: A visitor uses the responsive site navigation
acceptance: the mobile header includes a visible booking call-to-action
the mobile menu can be opened and closed
all primary navigation links are reachable on mobile

acceptance.statement: clicking 'Book a picking slot' on the home page opens the booking page and displays available dates.
submitting a booking without a customer name, valid email, phone or accepted terms shows visible inline validation messages and does not create a confirmation.
after a successful booking, the confirmation displays a booking reference, selected date, selected time, party size and arrival instructions.
a submitted active booking is readable after a full page reload by entering its booking reference and matching email.
when remaining capacity for a slot is less than the selected party size, submitting the booking shows 'That slot is no longer available' and no booking confirmation is created.
a full slot is visibly labelled 'Full' or 'Sold out' and cannot be selected.
looking up a booking with the correct reference but a different email shows 'We could not find that reservation' and does not display the booking details.
cancelling an active booking changes its displayed status to 'Cancelled' and removes the active cancel button.
the home, visit and our farm pages each display the Berry Brook Farm name and a persistent header book call-to-action.
on a mobile-width viewport, opening the menu reveals links for Home, Book Now, Plan Your Visit and Our Farm.

operations.description: Persist a new active reservation with generated booking reference, selected date, selected 90-minute slot, party size, customer contact details and accepted terms.
Find and display a reservation only when booking reference and customer email match.
Update an active booking to status 'Cancelled' and record a cancellation timestamp.
Persist a newsletter signup email and show a visible success message.

integrations.name: none
integrations.purpose: The demo uses in-app seeded availability, stored booking records and visual placeholders instead of external services.
